headline: Double Dragon gives the seat back
lede: Walk away from a co-op run mid-fight and the computer now takes your brother's seat instead of leaving him parked under the lamps — and one fresh press hands it straight back to you.

notes.text: Jon's answers on #2908/#2930 ("Yes. Computer takes over.") shipped as law: five seconds of silence on P2 and dragonBrain resumes Jimmy; any press re-seats with the full join flare — the returning friend gets the same welcome as an arriving one.
The idle clock lives inside the sim's fixed step, so replays and training takes reproduce the exact seat timeline; ownership never touches stateHash — every pre-existing seed pin held untouched.

The handback reads like the join shout's mirror: grey brackets close onto the seat, a soft two-note descent rings, pad 2 gives a short rumble — and the READY blink keeps inviting you back while the CPU holds the seat.

QA pass filed for the craft left open (#3007): the grey ink at phone scale, the descent under machine-gun fire, and whether five seconds is the right number for a player who is just thinking, not walking away.
